speech.heard: In Turkey, children enter middle school at 10. In Namibia, they wait until 14. In Brazil and the UK, students make that transition at 11. This benchmark assumes students entered on time and progressed without repeating any grade. Climbing the ladder, the USA, Japan and China all begin at 12. Moving higher, Denmark and Indonesia wait until students reach 13. At the very top, Namibia has the world's highest starting age at 14. At what age do students enter lower secondary school in your country?
